verdict: A very close rebuild whose layout lands within a few pixels everywhere, let down by loose letter-spacing on every text and by substitute icons in the tab bar and top bar; it is cleanly built with flex and templates, but section headers and cards are copied by hand.

top_defects.where: all text (Card hidden, Footballeur français, Activity, Play today's game)
top_defects.what: the fallback font renders with loose, uneven tracking (gaps such as 'hidde n', 'Activit y', 'Footballeur français' set wider than the reference's SF Pro); the lines run several px longer
Material icons stand in for SF Symbols: the home glyph has no roof overhang, the bookmark is rounded with a shallow notch, the clock hands differ
the Lucide copy icon and the outlined account_circle replace the reference's tabs icon and filled person-in-circle; strokes are heavier and the shapes differ
the glass is nearly opaque white/90: the blurred 'Liste de … Wikipédia' row that shows through in the reference is barely visible
the title and description sit about 2–4 px higher than in the reference, and row 3 and its rank circle are a few px off behind the tab bar
the Star Academy logo is cropped and scaled differently: the full logo is shown smaller instead of the reference's tight crop

top_defects.where: Games / Top read section headers and cards
top_defects.what: the two section headers and the card shells are copied by hand (same classes and magic numbers); the 156 arbitrary values include no shared tokens
the SVG image is recolored with a CSS filter hack (invert/sepia/hue-rotate) to approximate #3366cc instead of using an icon in a real color

strengths: The block geometry (status bar, top bar, segmented control, Today, toast, cards, tab bar) matches the reference to within a few px, at the right size
The measured palette is used exactly: #202122, #72777d, #3366cc, the toast's #f7f8fa
Event rows, article rows and tab items each come from a data template, and the feed flows in flex columns
